Severe Crises. Silent Headlines.

Download the tables behind the SA Analytical dashboard maps as CSV or Excel files, with sources and licences.

← Back to the dashboard

These are the tables behind the dashboard maps, one per tab. Each table can be searched and sorted here, or downloaded as a CSV or Excel file. Every file names its sources and licences; the Excel files also have a Notes sheet explaining each column. Please credit the original data providers when you use the data.

Updated 04 November 2026. The Funding (beta) tab is not included.

Global vulnerability map

Crisis indicators and the INFORM Risk Index for every country with data.
